title: Crucible
description: The &3Crucible&r is an important machine as it is the central component of metallurgy. It is used as a method of ore processing, alloying, and metal casting. It requires an external heat source to melt the inputs into liquids and when filled, it emits a consistent amount of soot that can cause a fair amount of pollution that cannot be mitigated. Some alloys, as mentioned before, can be made alternatively using a &3Blast Furnace&r, however this is generally slower.
Press [F1] for more info on applicable items
It is recommended that the wiki is checked out.
